acanthus-vase-between-two-female-chimera.description: An upright engraved panel. A lidded fluted vase with a bearded mask on its bowl stands at the centre on a pair of scaly serpent coils; a female chimera stands at either side, with a woman's head and torso, a scaled lower body curling into a serpent tail and lion-pawed feet, each gripping the vase rim. From the vase rise acanthus leaves and thin stems that curl symmetrically into two large tulip-like flowers, two round blossoms and small leaf tendrils up to a central finial. Black and grey line work with cream paper-toned fills; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: A Vase between Two Chimeric Figures

acanthus-vase-between-two-female-chimera.title: Vase between two female chimeras
usage_notes: Tall upright panel (about 1 to 2); the chimeras and the vase form its base, so place it standing, not rotated.

bearded-mask-with-eagle-and-paired-fauns.description: A nearly rectangular engraved grotesque. A large bearded mask with a furrowed brow stares out from the centre under a pine-cone finial on a stand; two fruit-filled cornucopias hung with ribbons flank it, and a parrot-like bird perches on a scroll in each upper corner. At the lower sides two horned fauns with scaled fish tails face inward, holding a cloth that drapes behind an eagle with spread wings and talons at the bottom centre. Brown-black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament Design with a Mask and an Eagle between Two Fauns Below

bearded-mask-with-eagle-and-paired-fauns.title: Bearded mask with eagle, cornucopias and fauns
usage_notes: Dense near-rectangular panel (about 3 to 4); it reads as a plate or a tile, not as a border.

bearded-mask-with-tritons-and-two-childr.description: A nearly rectangular engraved grotesque. A large bearded mask with an open mouth fills the centre; above it a small bearded man sits astride its crest and stretches a cloth to two horned goat heads in the upper corners, while a booted man in a jerkin perches on a cornucopia at either side. Below, a nude child rides a woman's bust at the left and another stands on a bearded satyr's head at the right; a lion mask with a draped cloth and a small lower mask among acanthus leaves close the bottom. Brown-black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament Design with a Mask, A Couple of Tritons, and Two Children Below

bearded-mask-with-tritons-and-two-childr.title: Grotesque with mask, goat heads and children
usage_notes: Dense near-rectangular panel (about 3 to 4); it reads as a plate or a tile, not as a border.

branching-scroll-with-broad-lobed-leaves.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1912.85
branching-scroll-with-broad-lobed-leaves.description: A horizontal foliate ornament. From a leafy base at the bottom centre a straight stem rises to a bell-shaped flower on a ringed collar, and symmetrical stems branch to either side, curling into volutes dressed with broad lobed leaves and drooping buds. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.

provenance.institution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg
provenance.object_title: Laubwerkfüllung

branching-scroll-with-broad-lobed-leaves.quality: Low-resolution master (469 px wide); do not display it larger than its native size.
branching-scroll-with-broad-lobed-leaves.title: Branching leaf scroll with bell flower
usage_notes: Reads as a headpiece or tailpiece; the central flower marks the axis.

child-gripping-wide-foliate-scroll.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. A nude putto crouches at the centre with its head turned to the left, gripping the stems that run through both hands, while a small bell flower rises above its head; broad lobed leaves on thin curling stems spread symmetrically to both ends, with a small bud at each edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament with Foliage and a Child in the Center
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

child-gripping-wide-foliate-scroll.quality: The leaves at the left and right edges are cut by the plate edge of the print.
child-gripping-wide-foliate-scroll.title: Putto gripping a wide leaf scroll
usage_notes: The scroll is cut by the plate edge at both ends; it suits a headpiece or a band but will not tile.

female-headed-beasts-candelabrum.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O2013.2
female-headed-beasts-candelabrum.description: A tall candelabrum grotesque. A hairy mask at the top holds ribbons and stems in its mouth; below it two feline-bodied beasts with raised tails stand back to back, their long necks ending in two women's heads at the sides, and a blank tablet hangs between them above a palmette. Two flaming bowls stand on fluted brackets at the sides, and two lizard-like beasts grip the stems at the bottom around a cup with ears of grain. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.

provenance.institution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg
provenance.object_title: Kandelabergroteske

female-headed-beasts-candelabrum.quality: Low-resolution master (225 px wide); do not display it larger than its native size.
female-headed-beasts-candelabrum.title: Candelabrum with female-headed beasts and lizards
usage_notes: The blank tablet in the middle can carry a short caption.

fish-and-flower-candelabrum-scroll.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate candelabrum. A thin central shaft rises through tiers of acanthus leaves and volutes; two fish-tailed dolphins with open jaws face each other across the middle, two more look outward at the base, and round roses sit in the volutes near the top under a small finial. Black and grey line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament Design with Fishes

fish-and-flower-candelabrum-scroll.title: Candelabrum with fish and roses
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

fluted-vase-with-horns-and-broad-leaf-sc.description: A horizontal foliate ornament. A gadrooned vase at the bottom centre sends up a straight stem with layered acanthus leaves, and two flared trumpet-shaped horns lean outward above it; broad curled leaves, hanging bell flowers and pea-pod-like buds spread symmetrically to both sides, with a bell flower cut off at each edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

fluted-vase-with-horns-and-broad-leaf-sc.quality: The bell flowers at the left and right edges are cut by the plate edge of the print.
fluted-vase-with-horns-and-broad-leaf-sc.title: Fluted vase with trumpet horns and leaf scroll
usage_notes: Reads as a headpiece or tailpiece with the vase as its base.

leafy-shaft-with-bearded-and-lion-masks.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate ornament. From a hairy bearded mask at the base, flanked by two pod-like gourds on curled stems that end in lion paws, a central shaft rises through a lion mask set in a shield-shaped cartouche, two roses, a ribbon and a bearded mask with wild hair, up to a leafy calyx with two volute horns, beads and hanging buds at the top; thin acanthus stems curl outward along the whole height. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

leafy-shaft-with-bearded-and-lion-masks.title: Leafy shaft with bearded mask and lion mask
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

leafy-stems-on-hairy-base.description: A narrow upright strip cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. Grass-like stalks with small lobed leaves and buds rise from a rounded tuft of hair-like hatching at the bottom; the left side is a straight cut where the couple stood in the print. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament with Naked Couple
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

leafy-stems-on-hairy-base.quality: Low-resolution master (201 px wide) with a straight cut along the left edge; no face is legible in the hairy base despite the id.
leafy-stems-on-hairy-base.title: Leafy stems on a hairy base
usage_notes: Crop from the same sheet as the couple and the tall grotesque; the straight left edge is where it abutted the couple, so place something against that side or keep it at the right of a composition.

nude-couple-standing.description: A nude man and woman stand side by side, cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. The woman at the left faces the viewer with her head turned toward the man, her braided hair streaming out to the left, a girdle at her hips and a small rod held upright in her right hand; the man at the right stands in profile facing left, one arm around her shoulders and his open hand under hers. Fine black engraved hatching with cream paper-toned skin on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament with Naked Couple
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

nude-couple-standing.title: Nude couple standing
usage_notes: Crop from the same sheet as the leafy stems and the tall grotesque; the figures touch at shoulder, hands and feet and must stay together.

paired-horns-sprouting-broad-leafy-tendr.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. Two short horns rise from a central pair of volutes and are tied together by a bow at the top, with an upright vine leaf between them; broad lobed leaves on curling stems spread symmetrically to both ends, with volutes along the base and a curled leaf at each outer corner. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Horizontal Panel with Two Tendrils Sprouting Upwards from Horns at Center

paired-horns-sprouting-broad-leafy-tendr.title: Two horns with vine-leaf scroll
usage_notes: Complete at both ends; reads as a headpiece or a band.

paired-tendrils.description: A horizontal opaque engraved panel on a dark cross-hatched ground. A stem rises from a small block bearing the AG monogram at the bottom centre to a bud at the top, and two leafy tendrils curl outward from it into large volutes at either end, with lobed leaves filling the corners. Cream leaves on a black hatched ground; only the margin outside the panel is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Horizontal Panel with Two Tendrils Sprouting from the Center, Ending in Volutes

paired-tendrils.title: Tendril panel with AG monogram
usage_notes: Opaque panel with its original hatched ground; place it as a plate, not as a cut-out.
The AG monogram at the bottom centre is part of the print and should stay visible.

seated-child-holding-tall-leafy-scroll.description: An upright foliate ornament. A nude putto sits at the bottom centre facing the viewer, holding an upright stem in one hand and a curling stem in the other; from these a tall acanthus scroll branches upward and sideways with broad curled leaves, tulip-like buds and a trumpet flower, filling a roughly rectangular field. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Scroll Ornament with Seated Child
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

seated-child-holding-tall-leafy-scroll.title: Seated putto holding a leaf scroll
usage_notes: The putto is the base of the composition; keep it upright.

soldier-profile-in-fruiting-dagger-sheat.description: A tall tapering ornament designed for a dagger sheath. At the top a helmeted soldier's head in profile faces left inside a wreath of leaves and buds; below it a stem runs down the centre through curled acanthus leaves, a volute and rows of pod-like fruits hanging from short stems, narrowing to a point at the bottom. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Dagger Sheath with Profile of a Soldier Supported by Tendrils

soldier-profile-in-fruiting-dagger-sheat.title: Dagger sheath with soldier's head
usage_notes: Very tall and narrow (about 1 to 4.5); it suits a page margin or a vertical rule, head at the top.

sphinxes-and-cornucopias-in-tall-candela.description: A tall narrow symmetrical candelabrum grotesque. Two winged sphinxes with women's heads sit back to back at the base, their wings rising into volutes; above them two fruit-filled cornucopias cross under a knotted ribbon, two roses sit in the scrolls, a bearded mask with leafy hair faces out from the upper middle between two butterflies, and two large flowers hang from the volutes under a small vase finial, all joined by thin acanthus stems and strings of beads. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Vertical Panel with Candelabrum Grotesques Containing Cornucopias and Sphinxes

sphinxes-and-cornucopias-in-tall-candela.title: Candelabrum with sphinxes and cornucopias
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 2.8); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

tall-grotesque-with-female-and-animal-he.description: A tall narrow foliate grotesque cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. A woman's bust with curled ram's horns and leafy wings faces the viewer at the top under two hanging bell flowers; below her a layered acanthus calyx carries two lion-like heads in profile facing inward, a frowning cat-like mask stares out from the centre, and curled leaves descend to a scalloped cup terminal at the bottom. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament with Naked Couple
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

tall-grotesque-with-female-and-animal-he.title: Grotesque with winged woman and lion heads

Crop from the same sheet as the couple and the leafy stems.

tall-shaft-with-masks-and-dolphins.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate ornament. Under a leafy crown at the top two bearded grotesque masks in profile face outward; below them two dolphin-like creatures with open jaws curl away from the shaft, two small roses sit on the stems, a fluted collar holds hanging pear-shaped pods, and tiers of broad acanthus leaves, volutes and pea pods descend to a leafy base. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Sprig of Ornamental Foliage with Two Masks and Two Dolphins
provenance.rights_text: Open Access / public domain; official image dataset openaccess=1

tall-shaft-with-masks-and-dolphins.title: Leafy shaft with two masks and dolphins

two-boys-with-vine-scroll.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. A nude boy stands at the far left facing right, one hand on his hip and the other raised to a stem; a second nude boy stands near the centre facing right, grasping a stem above his head and stretching his other arm along the scroll; thin curling stems with broad lobed vine leaves fill the rest of the panel to the right edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

two-children-in-tall-fruiting-leaf-scrol.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1907.751
two-children-in-tall-fruiting-leaf-scrol.description: A tall narrow foliate panel. Two putti sit at the bottom, one in a short tunic facing right behind a nude one facing the viewer, both holding stems; above them a dense scroll of thin stems with lobed leaves, buds and pod-like fruits fills the whole height. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.

provenance.institution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg
provenance.object_title: Laubwerkfüllung mit zwei Putten

two-children-in-tall-fruiting-leaf-scrol.quality: Low-resolution master (143 px wide); do not display it larger than its native size.
two-children-in-tall-fruiting-leaf-scrol.title: Two putti under a tall leaf scroll
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.3); it suits a page margin at a small size.

two-satyr-couples-on-foliate-candelabrum.description: A tall candelabrum grotesque in two tiers. At the top two satyrs seated on scrolls, a long-haired one at the left and a goat-horned bearded one at the right, raise a tiered fluted vase of foliage with a small lizard among its leaves; a palmette separates the tiers. Below, a female satyr with a plumed headdress at the left and a bearded male at the right sit facing a horned goat skull at the centre, each holding a curved horn; all four have goat legs and hooves. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Ornament with Two Couples of Satyrs

two-satyr-couples-on-foliate-candelabrum.title: Candelabrum with two pairs of satyrs
usage_notes: Upright piece (about 1 to 2); the two tiers can be cropped apart at the palmette if a shorter piece is needed.

urn-with-three-tiers-of-foliate-scrolls.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1907.754
urn-with-three-tiers-of-foliate-scrolls.description: A tall narrow symmetrical candelabrum. From a gadrooned urn at the bottom a central shaft rises through three tiers of paired volutes, each holding a large round flower, past a shouting mask in the lower middle and a blank tablet in the upper middle, to a cup with ears of grain at the top; thin acanthus stems with small leaves and beads fill the sides. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.

provenance.institution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg
provenance.object_title: Kandelabergroteske

summary: Foliate panels, candelabrum grotesques, masks, satyrs, children and a dagger sheath engraved by Heinrich Aldegrever in Soest, about 1525–1555, from twenty sheets in Cleveland, New York, Hamburg and Washington; loose prints by one artist, grouped by sheet.
title: Heinrich Aldegrever ornament prints
